howto.name: Upload a PDF
howto.text: Drop a PDF up to 500 MB.

howto.name: PrivaTools pulls out every image
howto.text: Each embedded image (raster or vector) is extracted at its native resolution, with original format preserved (JPEG, PNG, TIFF, etc.).

howto.name: Download as ZIP
howto.text: All extracted images are bundled into a ZIP archive, named by page and order.

faq.q: Will the images be the original resolution?
faq.a: Yes. PDF embeds images at the resolution set when the PDF was created — extraction recovers them unchanged.

faq.q: What if the same image appears multiple times?
faq.a: Each visual occurrence is extracted, even if it's the same underlying image data. Use deduplication after if needed.

faq.q: Does it work on scanned PDFs?
faq.a: Yes — each page of a scanned PDF is one big image. The tool extracts that page-image directly.
